body:
Files changed:

- [source.rs](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/source/crates/scenerender/src/source.rs): renderer and placeholder MediaSource implementations.
- [lib.rs](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/source/crates/scenerender/src/lib.rs): configuration, entry points, cached probing, and re-exports.
- [source_tests.rs](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/source/crates/scenerender/src/source_tests.rs): 24 source tests, including the opt-in oracle.
- [Cargo.toml](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/source/crates/scenerender/Cargo.toml): permitted workspace log dependency.

Public API:

```rust
pub struct Env {
    pub config: discover::Config,
    pub cache_dir: Option<PathBuf>,
    pub quality: Quality,
    pub chunk_len: u64,
    pub timeout: Duration,
    pub memory_budget: usize,
}
impl Default for Env;

pub struct Opened {
    pub source: SharedSource,
    pub status: discover::Status,
    pub warning: Option<String>,
}

pub fn open(path: &Path, bytes: &[u8], env: &Env) -> filmcraft_media::Result<Opened>;
pub fn open_with(path: &Path, bytes: &[u8], env: &Env,
    program: Option<PathBuf>, runner: Arc<dyn process::Runner>)
    -> filmcraft_media::Result<Opened>;
pub fn probe(config: &discover::Config) -> discover::Status;
```

Also re-exported Config, Status, PlaceholderSource, and native SceneRenderSource. Both sources implement MediaSource; construct them through the open functions.

Design notes:

- Metadata comes only from the header. Video uses memory → disk → validated chunk rendering, with per-source serialization, a global process limit, cancellation, and remembered chunk failures.
- Actual renderer behavior differs from the plan: `render --quality draft` writes half-size PNGs. These are validated and expanded to header size, including odd dimensions.
- Audio streams through WavSource::open and its resampler. Metadata declares 48 kHz stereo/24-bit PCM. Mono is duplicated; wider WAVs currently expose their first two channels. Failures log once and return silence.
- Without disk caching, video staging is removed after loading; the audio temporary file remains until source drop for streaming.
- System probes cache by resolved executable path, length, and mtime. Injected probes bypass that cache. Native executable paths retain their original OS representation.
- Bounds include 256 MiB frame memory, 65,536 frames per chunk, and 1,048,576 audio frames per request.

TDD red → green:

- Round 1: 15 failures → 16 passing source tests. `source_invalid_header_is_decode` expected Decode but received the Unsupported stub; `source_probe_is_cached_and_invalidated_by_file_size` expected found=true. The remaining tests failed opening with `Unsupported("source stub")`: `source_info_identical_and_placeholder_cached`, `source_memory_disk_and_chunk_hits`, `source_quality_and_draft_have_separate_caches`, `source_threads_render_chunk_once`, `source_failures_are_remembered_and_publish_nothing`, `source_cancellation_does_not_start_or_poison_chunk`, `source_hostile_requests_one_frame_and_zero_chunk`, `source_bad_cache_path_is_error_not_panic`, `source_no_disk_cache_keeps_chunk_in_memory_and_cleans_temp`, `source_audio_streams_resamples_and_reuses_disk`, `source_audio_failure_silences_once`, `source_audio_out_of_range_and_allocations_are_bounded`, and `source_old_or_failed_probe_falls_back_with_warning`.
- Round 2: three failures → all green. `source_draft_accepts_renderer_half_size_and_restores_header_size` rejected 1×1 draft output for a 2×2 header; `source_native_program_paths_are_lossless` rejected a non-UTF-8 executable path; `source_invalid_wav_signature_is_not_published` returned nonzero samples from an invalid WAV.
- Full transcripts: [first red](/home/admin/src/render-frontend-js/PALS-Notes/projects/ops/filmcraft-scene/agents/source/vm-red1.log), [second red](/home/admin/src/render-frontend-js/PALS-Notes/projects/ops/filmcraft-scene/agents/source/vm-red2.log), [final green](/home/admin/src/render-frontend-js/PALS-Notes/projects/ops/filmcraft-scene/agents/source/vm-green2b.log).

Final VM results: clippy `--all-targets -- -D warnings` passed; 111 crate tests passed, zero failed; wasm32-unknown-unknown check passed. The oracle skipped because SR_RENDER_BIN was unset; no executable was found in the VM’s PATH or checked build locations. All changed Rust files were rustfmt-ed.

Integrator: update Cargo.lock for log. No merged building-block modules changed. No commits or pushes were made. Task locks are released.
